leadText: Volcanion (Japanese: ボルケニオン Volcanion) is a major character who appeared in Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel.
plainText:
Volcanion (Japanese: ボルケニオン Volcanion) is a major character who appeared in Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel.

==In the movies==
 
A long time ago, Volcanion met at the Nebel Plateau. The two became friends, as Magearna was able to fold up to protect herself whenever Volcanion exploded. Since then, Volcanion had been protecting Magearna at the plateau.

In the movie, Volcanion first appears chasing after an airship driven by Cherie and Levi. Volcanion states that he has come to retrieve something, but Levi fights it off with his Mega and . During the battle, Levi manages to fit an electronic band around one of its legs, though Volcanion deflects a second band before it is launched off the ship, falling and crashes down to where and are. While Ash and the group are not severely hurt, they discover that the band that Volcanion had deflected earlier is now attached to Ash. Volcanion tries to leave, only for Ash to be forcibly pulled toward the band on Volcanion's leg. Despite its distate towards humans, Volcanion reluctantly allows Ash to stay by it as Volcanion flies off in pursuit of Levi and Cherie toward the Azoth Kingdom. 

Volcanion appears at the kingdom where Alva is receiving Magearna from his henchmen. Volcanion confronts them but Alva begins to ward it off with his Mega-Evolved Gengar along with Alakazam and Glalie. Volcanion becomes frozen, but as it thaws, Ash's other Pokémon arrive and assist Volcanion in overwhelming the three Mega-Evolved Pokémon. The ensuing confusion allows Volcanion to escape with Magearna who flee to Nebel Plateau, unwillingly bringing along Ash and the group.

The next day, Alva and his forces invade the Nebel Plateau, flooding the area with smoke. While Volcanion tries to retaliate, Volcanion and Ash become trapped by and . Alva's forces threaten Magearna that they will torture the humans and Pokémon until it submits and goes with them. Unable to watch its friends get tortured, Magearna surrenders and is taken to Alva. Angered, Volcanion, along with the group, goes off to the Azoth Kingdom to save Magearna. 

At the kingdom, the group defeat Alva and his forces. However, they realize they had come too late, with Magearna having appeared to have lost her memory and personality. They also find out that the fortress they are in is spiraling out of control and will crash into the Nebel Plateau. The group plan to explode the fortress in the air with Volcanion's power, while the rest flee in Kimia's airship. While Volcanion plans to destroy the castle from within the engine room, Ash refuses to let Volcanion carry the plan out as he realizes it will be a suicide mission. Ash tells Volcanion to explode outside so that it could escape as well. However, while Volcanion helps the humans and Pokémon evacuate the castle, after they leave, it jumps back inside, intending to sacrifice itself. Apologizing for not being able to save Magearna, Volcanion explodes once Kimia has completed the evacuation, completely destroying the fortress.

Later, as the others are mourning for its death, Volcanion appears injured, but still alive. It struggles to Magearna's side, in the process shocking Magearna into regaining her memory and personality. However, it collapses soon after, apparently having died of its injuries. The group mourns anew, and Magearna produces flowers, whose pollen gets in Volcanion's nose and makes it sneeze, reviving it. To thank the Pokémon who helped it rescue Magearna, Volcanion gives them the title of honorary members of the Nebel Plateau.

In the credits, Volcanion assists the Pokémon of Nebel Plateau in removing and burying the wreckage of Alva's fortress. Volcanion continues watching over the others from its cave, ensuring they all can live in peace. 

===Personality and characteristics===
Volcanion is very protective of both Magearna as well as the Pokémon living in Nebel Plateau. It would do anything it can to keep them safe from harm. 

It also does not trust humans nor the Pokémon belonging to humans, and it reveals that all of the Pokémon living at Nebel Plateau were harmed by humans and thus fear them. However, over time, Ash and the others begin to regain Volcanion's trust for humans by bringing out their own Pokémon and assisting in the treatment of an injured . At the end, Volcanion allows the group, including the humans, to be called honorary Nebel Plateau Pokémon.

==In the games==
This Volcanion was distributed to players of and who inserted a serial code, which was included on preordered tickets for Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel in Japan, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Singapore, and South Korea.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

===In the spin-off games===
====Pokémon Ga-Olé====
Volcanion appears in Pokémon Ga-Olé.

 
 
 
 

==In the TCG==
===Merchandise===
====XY11 accessories====
The dual and expansion also saw the release of several TCG protection and storage accompaniments.

Deck case: The Volcanion & Mega Gardevoir Deck Case (Japanese: デッキケース ボルケニオン・メガサーナイト Deck Case: Volcanion•Mega Sirnight) utilizes elements of the expansion's booster pack artwork, featuring on the front and both and on reverse. The case comes with 2 similarly illustrated card dividers and has space to store at least 90 cards in sleeves, or 180 loose cards.

Deck case image:
 

====Volcanion-EX Special Jumbo Card Pack====
The Volcanion-EX Special Jumbo Card Pack (Japanese: スペシャルジャンボカードパック「ボルケニオンEX」) was released on August 5, 2016 following the Japanese opening of Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel, which starred and . Volcanion is featured as a reprinted Jumbo card and Magearna as a new promotional card. The pack also comes with 4 booster packs, 2 booster packs, and 2 booster packs.

Sleeves: Each pack contains 32 card sleeves.
The Volcanion Sleeves (Japanese: デッキシールド ボルケニオン Deck Shield: Volcanion) feature the same 5ban Graphics illustration of as the booster pack art complete with the expansion's industrial city theme in the background.

Promotional cards:
( 268)
(XY-P Promo; Jumbo)

Product images:
 

==Trivia==
In protecting Pokémon who live in remote, forested highlands, had been harmed by humans, and fear humans, Volcanion resembles another Pokémon featured in a movie, Mewtwo (M01), who protected such Pokémon on Cero Island.
